rationale: The snatch theft on July 6 fell inside the covered trip (July 2-12), was reported to the tourist police within 24 hours, and receipts support the electronics, so Baggage and Personal Effects (wording s5) applies; a snatch from the person is never unattended belongings (manual s7). Premium per-item limits are not exceeded (electronics at $1,200 with Electronics Plus, tote at $95 needs no receipt as it is $100 or less): $429 + $180 + $399 + $95 = $1,103, less the $50 Premium deductible (wording s10) = $1,053, within the $1,500 maximum. The payout is above $1,000, so payment needs handler sign-off (manual s3); this is the customer's first claim.
